propositions: T13, T14, removal-rationale, and asserted-capability criteria have produced zero findings across ~7,900 agentic runs, wasting executions.
A deterministic pre-filter gate skips LLM routing for a criterion only when its subject vocabulary is entirely absent, leaving the ADR-0034 LLM router as the applicability authority for fired plans.
DetGateRule fires when all text_all regexes match the plan text, or any file_impact path matches a glob, or file_impact_reason_re matches an entry's reason or path.
asserted-capability requires both a module-ref leg and a capability-verb leg to match before firing (conjunction).
Skipped criteria are recorded in the REVIEW_RESULT sidecar under coverage.routing.det_gated keyed by criterion id with the rule name, threaded via a gate_log parameter.
Existing overlay rules T5a/T5d/T7/T12 migrate to DetGateRule one-element text_all rules with behavior preserved.
